description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, the Twins and Leslie White share a common mistake buyers make during the home buying process — making big changes right before closing.

From quitting a job to getting married the same day, these changes can impact your loan and delay your closing.

The key is simple: keep everything consistent until the transaction is complete.

If you're buying a home in Central Texas real estate, understanding this can help you avoid unnecessary stress and delays.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, home buying tips, and real estate insights.
